annotations.title: Atlas United data, all datasets (advanced / multi-county)

description: The full API in one tool. The other tools cover the common questions (get_storm_history: one county, past 365 days; get_risk_forecast: one county, next 24 hours to 10 days; get_address_report: one address, past 365 days; get_property_storm_history_report: one address, 2003 to present; get_current_weather: one point, now and about the next two days). Use THIS tool for: every PAID address-level pull (set addresses=true), county coverage ($0.0002), facilities, wildfire (county-level), at_risk, daily, a counties multi-county rollup (comma-separated, max 15), hazard_score ($0.50), or any parameter the dedicated tools do not expose (radius_mi, date_of_loss, window, months, category, limit, kind, details, hours_ahead). Datasets: AtlasCast Forecast by Address (risk), Weather by Address (weather), Weather Forecast by Address (weather with hours_ahead), Storm History by Address (back to 2003) (history), Recent Storms by Address (last 365 days) (storms). Without a key, the tool returns the exact price quote (count + price) and a card pay link; with a key (new keys from $5, top-ups from $1, at https://atlasunited.io/api) or an x402 payment, it returns the data. Call with no arguments for the free full menu. License: own use only; no resale, redistribution or AI training.

addresses.description: Without a key, returns the exact price quote (count and price) and a pay link. With a key or x402 payment, true = address-level records ($0.03/record).

api_key.description: Advanced, normally leave empty: add your key in the connector's Authorization header instead of typing it in chat. Optional Atlas United API key (tfx_live_...).

city.description: City name, e.g. Austin. Send state too; can be used instead of county.

counties.description: Comma-separated county names (max 15) plus state, for a multi-county rollup.

county.description: County name without the word 'County', e.g. Dallas.

dataset.description: Target dataset. Default storms. One-peril products: <peril>_forecast (county+state+window, $0.01/address), <peril>_leads (county+state, last 365 days, $0.03/address), <peril>_history (address or lat+lon, since 2003, $0.03/line); wildfire_forecast is county-level (state, $0.02/county).

date_of_loss.description: dataset=history only. YYYY-MM-DD. Anchors the report around this date, returning the weather events recorded on and immediately around that date, for reference. Not a determination of whether any claim is valid.

days.description: Look-back window in days where supported.

details.description: dataset=weather only (Weather by Address). Billed $0.0002/call with a key or x402 payment; without a key, returns a price quote and pay link.

end.description: dataset=history only. YYYY-MM-DD end of the date range.

hours_ahead.description: dataset=weather only (a forecast hour). Forecast 0-48h out instead of current conditions; snaps to the nearest available forecast hour, and forecast_hour_used says what you got.

limit.description: Max records on the paid pull (default 2000, per-dataset caps still apply, e.g. storms caps at 5000).

months.description: dataset=storms only. Returns month-bucketed history totals instead of individual leads, for the last N months.

peril.description: Storm/risk type filter. Used by dataset=storms and dataset=risk (narrows to one storm type) and by dataset=at_risk (narrows to one peril bucket). Common storms values: HAIL, THUNDERSTORM_WIND, FLASH_FLOOD, HEAVY_RAIN, FLOOD, TORNADO. Forecast (risk) values: TORNADO, HAIL, WIND, FLASH_FLOOD, HEAVY_RAIN, WINTER, ICE, COASTAL_SURGE, HURRICANE, WILDFIRE.

radius_mi.description: dataset=history only. Search radius in miles. Default 5, max 25.

sandbox.description: true = free real data (up to 10 records) at the sandbox place only: 1100 Congress Ave, Austin, TX 78701 (lat 30.2747, lon -97.7404) or Travis County, TX. Elsewhere it has no effect.

sort.description: dataset=storms only. newest = newest storm first.

start.description: dataset=history only. YYYY-MM-DD start of the date range.

summary.description: true = County Summary: county grade and counts by storm type ($0.02 per county).

window.description: dataset=risk and the one-peril forecasts (<peril>_forecast). Forecast window. Default 24h.

x_payment.description: Advanced, for automated crypto payments only; leave empty. Optional signed x402 payment payload, used instead of an API key.
